phases.label: 质量智能底座
phases.goal: Make every future engine weakness visible, ranked, and actionable before release.

phases.label: 运行时性能极限
phases.goal: Push 2D runtime throughput, hot-path visibility, batching, culling, and worker ownership.

phases.label: 开发者体验与迁移
phases.goal: Reduce the cost of moving from Phaser, Construct, Cocos, and Pixi-only stacks.

phases.label: 编辑器生产化
phases.goal: Move the editor from useful tooling to daily production workflow.

phases.label: 生态、插件与平台发布
phases.goal: Make plugins, templates, marketplace, and platform exports trustworthy.

phases.label: 发布可信度与安全
phases.goal: Improve security, governance, compatibility, visual proof, and long-term maintenance.
